answer: Concrete mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. Today's words line up with the mechanism: cedar maps onto the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, pearl captures the way a public ledger splits one identity's activity into separable, linkable facets, and horizon embodies the transparency that makes every pattern visible. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
